events.title: Lunation 85 · Send the Invitation
events.description:
The plan for the last fifteen months is read and decided, and everyone is invited to choose their month.

Purpose: This is the threshold before the fifteen. In the two and a half weeks that remain, the stewards decide on this plan and the invitation goes out, so that everyone can choose their month and arrange to come.

What we propose:
• We propose that the stewards read this proposal for moon months 86-100 and, around the full moon on Tue 24 Nov, answer each month with yes, no or 'change this'.
• We propose that the invitation goes out around Tue 1 Dec: fifteen months, each with its name, its dates and one line on what it is for, so that people can pick their month, apply for membership if they need to, and book travel.
• We propose keeping a simple list of who answers and which month they choose, and handing it, together with the questions this proposal leaves open, to next month's 'why we began' circle, which turns the outline into a working calendar.
• Bringing in the last olives where there are still olives to pick (inferred), and closing the garden for winter.

Who it calls: The stewards first. Then everyone who has ever stayed, members who live far away, the people of the 2019 Hackalong, and anyone wondering when to come: this is the month to read the list and pick your moon. Very few people need to be on site.

The one thing that must happen: The stewards have given a clear answer to this proposal, and the invitation to the fifteen months has been sent before the new moon of Wed 9 Dec.

Kind of month: small and quiet.

events.title: Lunation 86 · Remember Why We Began
events.description:
A slow, dark winter month for writing and planning, with the winter solstice gathering on the longest night.

Purpose: Remember why the mission was born at the first Hackalong, and set an unhurried intention and rhythm for the last fifteen moon months of the first cycle.

What we propose:
• Long, quiet writing and coding time for people on a longer stay (the village's 'write your book' pillar).
• We propose a 'why we began' circle that drafts the calendar for the fifteen months.
• ReGenerativa's winter solstice gathering on the evening of Mon 21 Dec, the first of its sharing-economy gatherings in this plan (at the village, Casa Selva or both). We propose a fire where each person names one thing they will carry to the end of the cycle.
• Firewood and tool repair.

Who it calls: Writers, coders on a long project, planners, returning members, and people at a crossroads who are glad of a slow pace.

The one thing that must happen: The intention for moon months 86-100 is spoken aloud and a draft calendar exists.

Purpose: Rest and repair, in people and in the water system, so the building season grows on healthy ground.

• Clear the rainwater channels and the biolake, and repair the cisterns, before the dry months.
• We propose an inner-work and care residency with Casa Selva, if Laura and Casa Selva agree.
• Sow and pot on seedlings in the nursery.
• ReGenerativa's spring equinox gathering on Sat 20 Mar. We propose holding it at Casa Selva, so the village keeps its quiet month and the network still meets.

Who it calls: Therapists, carers, bodyworkers, musicians, gardeners, plumbers and water people, and tired changemakers who need a month that does not ask for output.

The one thing that must happen: One held space where the hard things of community life are spoken and met with care.
